name: A10-0147/2026 – Lukas Mandl – After § 33 – Am 12
title: REPORT on reinforcing development cooperation to address irregular population movements and their root causes in partner countries
part_text: 33a. Calls on the Commission to make development support for partner countries strictly conditional on effective cooperation on combating mass migration, including the prevention of irregular departures, consular identification, the issuing of travel documents, the systematic acceptance of returns and readmissions, and the fight against trafficking and smuggling networks; stresses that EU funding should be regularly assessed; calls on the Commission to systematically apply mechanisms for the suspension, reduction or reallocation of funding in such circumstances;
